title: The Ink on the Shared Table
youtube_title: The Ink on the Shared Table | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Golda is tangled up with an ink spot on the shared table and almost hides it. Golda tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
